caption: The drawing features a central, detailed, and colored depiction of a wooden, cylindrical object with a turned shape, composed of several stacked sections that create a profile with a wider top and base and a slightly narrower, concave middle. The object is colored in shades of light brown and beige, with visible lines and markings to suggest wood grain. Attached to the side of the lower section, there is a small metal lever or latch drawn in a similar realistic style. Surrounding this main illustration are two smaller, black-and-white line drawings of the same object, rendered in different views (one above-right and one below-left), showing the object's outline and internal features in simple, technical lines. The background is plain and off-white, and near the bottom right is the text "HARRY MANN WADDELL" printed in small, uppercase letters.
title: Butter Mold
